/* ============================================================
   HELPER FUNCTIONS
   ============================================================ */
const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
const randInt = (min, max) => Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
const clamp = (v, min, max) => Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));

/* ============================================================
   GAME STATE
   ============================================================ */
const state = {
    canvas: null,
    ctx: null,
    running: false,
    paused: false,
    gameOver: false,
    lastTime: 0,
    
    // Entities
    player: null,
    playerBullets: [],
    enemies: [],
    enemyBullets: [],
    barriers: [],
    ufo: null,
    particles: [],
    stars: [],
    
    // Logic
    score: 0,
    hiScore: 0,
    lives: 3,
    level: 1,
    enemyDirection: 1,
    enemyMoveTimer: 0,
    enemyMoveInterval: 1000, // ms
    enemyAnimTimer: 0,
    enemyAnimFrame: 0,
    ufoTimer: 0,
    canShoot: true,
    shootCooldown: 0,
    
    // Input
    keys: { left: false, right: false, fire: false, pause: false },
    touch: { x: null, startX: 0, playerStartX: 0 }
};

/* ============================================================
   INITIALIZATION
   ============================================================ */
function init() {
    state.canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
    state.ctx = state.canvas.getContext('2d');
    
    // Hi-Score
    state.hiScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('spaceInvadersHiScore')) || 0;
    updateUI();
    
    // Stars
    for(let i=0; i<100; i++) {
        state.stars.push({
            x: rand(0, CANVAS_W),
            y: rand(0, CANVAS_H),
            size: rand(0.5, 2),
            speed: rand(0.1, 0.5),
            color: COLORS.star[randInt(0, COLORS.star.length-1)],
            twinkle: rand(0, Math.PI*2),
            twinkleSpeed: rand(0.01, 0.05)
        });
    }
    
    // Event Listeners
    window.addEventListener('keydown', e => handleKey(e, true));
    window.addEventListener('keyup', e => handleKey(e, false));
    
    // Touch
    state.canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', handleTouchStart, {passive: false});
    state.canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, {passive: false});
    state.canvas.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    
    // Buttons
    document.getElementById('start-btn').addEventListener('click', startGame);
    document.getElementById('restart-btn').addEventListener('click', startGame);
    
    // Start Loop
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function handleKey(e, isDown) {
    const code = e.code;
    if (code === 'ArrowLeft' || code === 'KeyA') state.keys.left = isDown;
    if (code === 'ArrowRight' || code === 'KeyD') state.keys.right = isDown;
    if (code === 'Space' || code === 'ArrowUp' || code === 'KeyW') { 
        state.keys.fire = isDown; 
        if(isDown) e.preventDefault(); // Prevent page scroll
    }
    if (code === 'KeyP' || code === 'Escape') {
        if(isDown && state.running && !state.gameOver) togglePause();
    }
}

function handleTouchStart(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!state.running || state.gameOver) return;
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    const rect = state.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    state.touch.startX = touch.clientX - rect.left;
    state.touch.playerStartX = state.player.x;
}

function handleTouchMove(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!state.running || state.gameOver) return;
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    const rect = state.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const currentX = touch.clientX - rect.left;
    const dx = currentX - state.touch.startX;
    state.player.x = clamp(state.touch.playerStartX + dx * 1.5, state.player.width/2, CANVAS_W - state.player.width/2);
}

function handleTouchEnd(e) {
    if (!state.running || state.gameOver) return;
    // Tap to shoot logic: if touch duration short and movement small
    // Simplified: Fire on touch end if not moved much (handled by move)
    // Better: Fire on touchstart if not moving? 
    // Let's just allow fire button on screen or use a double tap? 
    // Standard mobile: Touch to move, separate fire button is better but we have no UI buttons.
    // Compromise: Tap (short touch < 200ms, small move) -> Fire. 
    // For simplicity in single file: Fire on touchstart if not dragging.
    // We'll implement a simple tap detection in start.
}

/* ============================================================
   GAME FLOW
   ============================================================ */
function startGame() {
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('visible');
    document.getElementById('gameOverOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('pauseOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('levelOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
    
    state.running = true;
    state.paused = false;
    state.gameOver = false;
    state.score = 0;
    state.lives = 3;
    state.level = 1;
    state.enemyDirection = 1;
    state.enemyMoveInterval = 1000;
    state.shootCooldown = 0;
    
    createPlayer();
    createEnemies();
    createBarriers();
    state.ufo = null;
    state.ufoTimer = rand(15, 30) * 1000; // 15-30 seconds
    state.particles = [];
    state.playerBullets = [];
    state.enemyBullets = [];
    
    updateUI();
    showLevelText(1);
}

function togglePause() {
    if (!state.running || state.gameOver) return;
    state.paused = !state.paused;
    document.getElementById('pauseOverlay').classList.toggle('hidden', !state.paused);
}

function gameOver() {
    state.running = false;
    state.gameOver = true;
    if (state.score > state.hiScore) {
        state.hiScore = state.score;
        localStorage.setItem('spaceInvadersHiScore', state.hiScore);
    }
    document.getElementById('finalScore').textContent = state.score.toString().padStart(5, '0');
    document.getElementById('gameOverOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
    updateUI();
}

function nextLevel() {
    state.level++;
    state.enemyMoveInterval = Math.max(150, state.enemyMoveInterval - 50); // Speed up
    state.enemyDirection = 1;
    createEnemies();
    createBarriers(); // Reset barriers
    state.playerBullets = [];
    state.enemyBullets = [];
    state.ufo = null;
    state.ufoTimer = rand(15, 30) * 1000;
    showLevelText(state.level);
}

function showLevelText(level) {
    const el = document.getElementById('levelOverlay');
    document.getElementById('levelText').textContent = `LEVEL ${level}`;
    el.classList.remove('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('hidden'), 2000);
}

function updateUI() {
    document.getElementById('score').textContent = state.score.toString().padStart(5, '0');
    document.getElementById('hiScore').textContent = state.hiScore.toString().padStart(5, '0');
    document.getElementById('lives').textContent = state.lives;
}

/* ============================================================
   ENTITY CREATION
   ============================================================ */
function createPlayer() {
    const w = 16 * 2; // Sprite width * scale
    const h = 10 * 2;
    state.player = {
        x: CANVAS_W / 2,
        y: CANVAS_H - 50,
        width: w,
        height: h,
        speed: 5,
        color: COLORS.player,
        detailColor: COLORS.playerDetail,
        alive: true,
        invincible: 0,
        sprite: SPRITES.player
    };
}

function createEnemies() {
    state.enemies = [];
    const rows = 5;
    const cols = 11;
    const spacingX = 50;
    const spacingY = 40;
    const startX = (CANVAS_W - (cols - 1) * spacingX) / 2;
    const startY = 80;
    
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            const type = ENEMY_TYPES[r];
            const spriteA = SPRITES[`enemy${r+1}A`];
            const spriteB = SPRITES[`enemy${r+1}B`];
            
            state.enemies.push({
                x: startX + c * spacingX,
                y: startY + r * spacingY,
                width: 12 * 2,
                height: 8 * 2,
                type: r,
                color: type.color,
                points: type.points,
                sprites: [spriteA, spriteB],
                currentFrame: 0,
                alive: true
            });
        }
    }
}

function createBarriers() {
    state.barriers = [];
    const barrierCount = 4;
    const barrierWidth = 12 * 2; // Sprite width * scale
    const barrierHeight = 8 * 2;
    const gap = (CANVAS_W - barrierCount * barrierWidth) / (barrierCount + 1);
    const y = CANVAS_H - 160;
    
    // Barriers are made of a grid of "blocks" (4x4 pixels logic units)
    // Sprite is 12x8 pixels (3 blocks wide, 2 blocks high)
    // We will store barrier health per block (3x2 grid per barrier)
    for (let i = 0; i < barrierCount; i++) {
        const bx = gap + i * (barrierWidth + gap);
        const blocks = [];
        for (let r = 0; r < 2; r++) { // 2 rows of blocks
            for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) { // 3 cols of blocks
                blocks.push({ x: c, y: r, health: 4 }); // 4 hits per block
            }
        }
        state.barriers.push({
            x: bx,
            y: y,
            width: barrierWidth,
            height: barrierHeight,
            blocks: blocks,
            blockSize: 4 * 2 // 4 logic pixels * scale 2
        });
    }
}

function spawnUFO() {
    if (state.ufo) return;
    const direction = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
    state.ufo = {
        x: direction === 1 ? -20 : CANVAS_W + 20,
        y: 50,
        width: 16 * 2,
        height: 7 * 2,
        speed: 2.5 * direction,
        color: COLORS.ufo,
        sprite: SPRITES.ufo,
        points: randInt(50, 300) // Mystery score
    };
}

/* ============================================================
   CORE GAME LOOP
   ============================================================ */
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
    const dt = timestamp - state.lastTime;
    state.lastTime = timestamp;
    
    if (state.running && !state.paused && !state.gameOver) {
        update(dt);
    }
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function update(dt) {
    // Player Invincibility
    if (state.player.invincible > 0) state.player.invincible -= dt;
    
    // Input
    if (state.keys.left) state.player.x -= state.player.speed * (dt/16);
    if (state.keys.right) state.player.x += state.player.speed * (dt/16);
    state.player.x = clamp(state.player.x, state.player.width/2, CANVAS_W - state.player.width/2);
    
    // Shooting
    state.shootCooldown -=
